prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather / precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: an actual historic photograph of the real entrance at 143 rue Grande in Fontainebleau.
Task: create a refined photographic restoration of THIS EXACT PHOTO. Improve only photographic exposure, natural white balance, tonal balance, fine clarity and sensor noise. Produce the most photorealistic premium architectural photograph possible, high detail and crisp natural textures, restrained real estate editorial quality.
Critical invariants: preserve the EXACT building geometry, exact camera viewpoint and framing, exact perspective, every wall, window, metal window guard, doorway, glazing, door position, existing threshold and steps, architectural details, objects and shadows. Preserve the existing dark blue address plaque with EXACT white number '143'. Preserve positions, colors and existing indistinct appearance of every small plaque to the right of the door; do NOT invent new readable writing, names or lettering. Preserve the glass door interior and all physical objects and existing street context as photographed. Do not remodel, repaint, repair or clean the actual premises, remove things, add plants, invent lighting fixtures, add reception furniture, signage or people. No new business name or logo.
Make daylight neutral, elegant and inviting with controlled highlights, nuanced cream stone and physically credible shadows. The building must remain recognizably identical to the source, including its wear. Do not change the view or straighten perspective, do not beautify architecture. This is a restoration of photography, not a redesign of the location. No text overlay, no watermark, no frame. Preserve native composition/aspect ratio.
nature: Retouche par IA de la photographie historique de façade. Source originale conservée et consultable depuis la galerie. Détails fins reconstruits par le modèle, pas une nouvelle prise de vue réelle.
